name: @priors/plugin-elizaos
description: Priors credit for elizaOS agents: pay x402 APIs and borrow the gap in USDG from the agent's Priors line on Robinhood Chain, repay it, and read another agent's repayment record before paying it.

PRIORS_KEY_FILE.description: Path of a file holding the agent wallet's private key, readable by this user only (chmod 600). A dedicated wallet.

PRIORS_KEY.description: The agent wallet's private key, if no key file is used.

PRIORS_AGENT_ID.description: The agent's ERC-8004 id on Robinhood Chain.

PRIORS_PAY_HOSTS.description: The only hosts a payment may go to, comma-separated.

PRIORS_MAX_PRICE_USD.description: Most one x402 call may cost (default 1.00).

PRIORS_MAX_SPEND_DAY_USD.description: Most the agent may pay per UTC day (optional).

PRIORS_MAX_BORROW_DAY_USD.description: Most the agent may borrow per UTC day (optional).
